title: Home Oxygen Therapy Flow Reference Card: Flow Range, Flow Adjustment Thresholds and Humidification
content:
# Flow Reference Card — Home Oxygen Therapy

Each Home Oxygen Therapy system class has a highest continuous flow it delivers, two prescribed-flow thresholds at which the stationary payment is adjusted, the size of each adjustment, and the flow above which a humidifier bottle is furnished.

| System class | Highest continuous flow delivered (LPM) | High-flow threshold (LPM) | High-flow uplift of the stationary payment (percent) | Low-flow threshold (LPM) | Low-flow reduction of the stationary payment (percent) | Humidifier bottle furnished above (LPM) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | 5 | 4 | 50 | 1 | 50 | 4 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 5 | 4 | 50 | 1 | 50 | 4 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | 5 | 4 | 50 | 1 | 50 | 4 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | 3 | 4 | 50 | 1 | 50 | 4 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | 15 | 4 | 50 | 1 | 50 | 4 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 10 | 4 | 50 | 1 | 50 | 4 |

## Definitions on this card

- **High-flow threshold**: the prescribed flow above which the high-flow adjustment applies. **High-flow uplift**: the increase of the stationary payment when the prescribed flow is above the high-flow threshold, in percent.
- **Low-flow threshold**: the prescribed flow below which the low-flow reduction applies. **Low-flow reduction**: the reduction of the stationary payment when the prescribed flow is below the low-flow threshold, in percent.
- **Highest continuous flow**: the highest continuous flow the system class delivers.
- **Humidifier bottle threshold**: the prescribed flow above which a humidifier bottle is furnished.

## Reading the thresholds (hypothetical prescriptions)

Both thresholds are strict: "above" and "below" exclude the threshold figure itself.

| Hypothetical prescribed flow | Against the high-flow threshold of 4 LPM | Against the low-flow threshold of 1 LPM | Humidifier bottle (above 4 LPM) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.5 LPM | not above | below | no |
| 1 LPM | not above | not below | no |
| 4 LPM | not above | not below | no |
| 4.5 LPM | above | not below | yes |

A hypothetical prescription of 6 LPM is above the highest continuous flow of Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) at 5 LPM and of Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) at 3 LPM, and within that of High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) at 10 LPM and Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) at 15 LPM.
